pages.text: Every placed totem gives off $(l)totem radiation$(). It is harmless: it is what lets a rival's $(l:totem/compass)Totem Compass$() find the totem.$(br2)Its level is one for each tier above Tier I plus every upgrade level. A Tier I totem with nothing bought gives off none.

The higher the level, the further away a compass sees the totem:$(br)$(li)Level 7: 9 blocks$(li)Level 27: 127$(li)Level 63: 689$(li)Level 120 and up: 2,500$(br2)Depth counts; ordinary blocks in between do not hide it.
pages.title: How far

pages.text: Far from a totem the needle points beside it, and closes in as you get nearer, so two bearings do not cross on the totem.$(br2)Your totem's screen shows its radiation along the bottom. $(l:radiation/coating)Totem Radiation Coating$() on shielding round it weakens it.
pages.title: Finding and hiding

pages.text: A new player's totems up to Tier II give off no totem radiation at all, so no compass finds them, until the player reaches the rank or the hours of play the server has chosen.$(br2)The bottom of the totem's screen says what ends it.
pages.title: New players
